title: Measuring and estimating on site
description: A contractor’s assistant for the initial measurement and the materials calculation. The scan of a space is assembled into an editable plan, and the measurements can be checked and refined before the estimate.

blocks.text: The contractor measures on site while the office prepares the materials calculation. If the plan can be sent straight away, the work continues without waiting for the crew to get back. But whoever receives it has to know which dimensions have already been checked.

quote.text: This app has helped us take our business to the next level. Measure in the field and have floor plans available immediately for the office to make quotes or order material. I don’t know how we ever made it with out this.

blocks.text: Assemble the rooms into an editable plan and keep the control measurements and photographs. Tie the area and materials calculation to a specific version of the plan. When a dimension is corrected, show which lines of the draft estimate were recalculated.

Walk one real space through the whole path: measurement, dimension check, handover to the office, correction. Find out whether the recipient can carry the calculation on without a second visit. One good experience does not confirm the accuracy of every scan; control measurements remain part of the job.
